subject: Dry run schedule: logs retention & sample extraction plan
messages:
From: Oliver Kent <audit_lead@dap.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: dry-run scope & log retention sampling

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. As part of StratusBank's upcoming assessment we want to run a short dry run so our auditors can exercise your evidence intake process and validate sampling scripts ahead of the scheduled FedRAMP/ISO check. Can you help on two things: 1) confirm the retention windows for the three classes of logs we discussed (control plane audit logs, inference runtime request logs, and KMS/crypto audit events), and 2) confirm a preferred sample extraction format (CSV vs NDJSON) and minimal fields for our team to request?

We're proposing a one-week dry run in the week of Aug 17; preferred slot is Wed Aug 18 morning PT. We'll plan for a 60–90 minute walkthrough plus a live pull of one contiguous sample window.

I've attached a short checklist of what we'll expect on the first pass (initial-evidence-checklist.csv). Please let us know if any of these items are gated or require redaction workflows.

Thanks,
Oliver Kent
Lead, Dexter Audit Partners
Audit lead for StratusBank

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Kent <audit_lead@dap.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: dry-run scope & log retention sampling

Hi Oliver,

Thanks — we can do the dry run. Wed Aug 18 at 10:00 PT works for me; I'll block 90 minutes and send a calendar invite once we confirm attendees. A couple quick clarifications so we bring the right artifacts: 

- Systems in scope: please confirm you want samples from (a) Redwood control plane audit logs (creates/modify/deploy actions), (b) inference runtime request logs (per-request metadata, not user payloads), and (c) KMS/key access audit events.
- Format: we prefer NDJSON for structured ingestion, but can provide CSV if you need it. NDJSON will include one JSON object per line with the fields described below.
- Redaction: we will not include customer PII or request payloads in the pull — only metadata fields. If the auditor needs to validate payload-level redaction, we'll need an approved scope from StratusBank legal.

Mina — can you confirm retention windows and a quick manifest we can attach to the dry-run? Also we'll want the runbook for extraction so Oliver has the exact field names.

I'll attach a short agenda in my invite.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Oliver Kent <audit_lead@dap.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: dry-run scope & log retention sampling — retention & manifest

Hi all,

Summary of retention policies and recommended sample manifest for the dry run: 

Retention windows (company default, subject to contractual overrides):
- Control plane audit logs (authentication, config changes, role assignments): 365 days (indexed, immutable snapshot).
- Inference runtime request metadata (timestamps, model id, latency, route, request_id): 90 days (aggregated metrics stored longer; raw per-request metadata 90 days).
- KMS/crypto audit events (key usage, key admin ops): 540 days (we forward to customer-managed logging where applicable).

Recommended extraction format and fields (preferred NDJSON):
- timestamp (ISO 8601), request_id, model, region, route, outcome_status (200/4xx/5xx), latency_ms, control_plane_event_type, actor_principal, a redaction_flag, checksum
- For KMS events: timestamp, event_type, key_id, principal, action (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey), request_id

Sampling guidance: one contiguous 7-day window is easiest for correlation. Provide a single compressed NDJSON file per log class and a manifest (evidence-manifest-2026-08-05.xlsx) listing file names, hashes, time range, and extraction query used. Evidence manifest attached.

Notes / gating items:
- We will redact customer-request payloads by default. If you need payload-level validation we will need a signed scoping addendum from StratusBank and legal signoff.
- For CAIQ/SIG mapping: Olga will attach a SOC 2 control map that ties each artifact to the relevant control ID.

Olga — can you add the SOC 2 control map and internal runbook link to this thread?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-manifest-2026-08-05.xlsx (XLSX, 48 KB)
